disposition_reason: The original offline stability comparison has ordered, published task-specific medians: isometric force R²=0.91 across 380 Jango pairs and reaching cursor-velocity R²=0.78 across 132 Chewie pairs. This grounds a complete source-task design, not readiness. Original partitions/preprocessing, author replay, metric/CV correspondence, source rights, uncertainty and budgets remain unresolved. The illustrated Day0→Day95 R²0.88 is calibration evidence and cannot establish the complete original task.

source_paper.title: Stabilizing brain-computer interfaces through alignment of latent dynamics

evidence.locator: Figures 2d, 3 and 4; Results: NoMAD stabilizes offline decoding during an unloaded reaching task; Methods: Neural decoding, Evaluation of decoding performance (Eq. 4), Data preprocessing and Data availability
evidence.supports: Reports separate isometric and reaching panel medians, original cohort/pair counts, variance-weighted R², behavior-free alignment and source decoder/preprocessing protocol. Figure 2d is only an illustrated pair.

evidence.locator: Final Nature Communications article, Results on unloaded reaching and Figure 4b–d
evidence.supports: Publisher article preserved by the German National Library confirms final reaching median R²0.78 for 132 ordered pairs from 12 sessions over 38 days; this differs from earlier preprint 0.77.

evidence.locator: Dataset, decoder training and alignment/evaluation notebook cells
evidence.supports: Author demonstration identifies Day0/Day95 processed-data workflow and fixed-decoder neural-only alignment, with trial/window choices requiring source correspondence. It is not the complete 512-pair original panel.
The demonstration uses Ridge.score and a 1e-5 to 1e5 alpha search; this is not the paper variance-weighted R²/ten-fold 1e1 to 1e5 decoder protocol.

Pinned terms restrict modifications/derivatives, distribution, competitive applications and use outside internal noncommercial research; source visibility is not authorization to ignore these restrictions.
Recovered operators preserve 512 directed pairs and broader scientific obligations but remain inactive source components with unresolved original recipes, identities and native qualification.

target.description: Stabilize the original offline neural-to-behavior decoders through neural-only alignment across the complete monkey session panels: isometric wrist force for Jango (Figure 3) and cursor velocity during reaching for Chewie (Figure 4). Preserve fixed reference decoders and original task-specific outputs; an illustrated Day0→Day95 pair alone cannot satisfy this task.

dataset.description: Paper Data availability identifies Jango_ISO_2015 and Chewie_CO_2016 recordings for the isometric and reaching tasks. The public demo supplies only a two-session Day0/Day95 route; authentic complete per-session files, original processing lineage and exact split manifests remain unresolved.

cohort.description: Original isometric panel: Monkey J/Jango, 20 sessions across 95 days and 380 ordered pairs. Original reaching panel: Monkey C/Chewie, 12 sessions across 38 days and 132 ordered pairs. Retain all 512 directed pairs and task-specific outcomes; source human online results are separate claims and are not established by these monkey panels.

split.description: For every original directed pair, preserve reference-day decoder fitting and behavior-hidden target-day neural alignment with held-out behavior scoring. Paper validation reserves 20% in blocks limiting overlap; the two-session demo selects 80% of valid reference trials without a fixed seed. Exact original trial identities, alignment exposure and scoring support are unresolved. A newly chosen split is an extension.

inputs.description: For each original pair, reference-day neural activity and allowed behavior train the latent model/decoder; target-day adaptation receives neural activity without target-day behavior labels. Final target-day force or cursor-velocity labels remain evaluator-owned and cannot influence adaptation or candidate selection.

preprocessing.description: Paper specifies 20-ms bins, channel exclusions/normalization, behavior-outlier handling and 600-ms overlapping training segments. Exact retained channels, filters, event clocks and original masks remain unresolved. Demo movement-onset windows cannot be equated silently to paper target-onset or other analysis windows.

metric.description: Paper Eq. 4 uses variance-weighted multi-output R²: 1 minus summed squared residuals across the original behavior dimensions divided by their summed centered target sums of squares. Preserve force and cursor-velocity target units separately. The paper names sklearn r2_score with multioutput=variance_weighted; pinned Ridge.score uses a different aggregation.

aggregation.description: Compute source variance-weighted R² for each directed session pair, then report separate medians over all 380 isometric pairs and all 132 reaching pairs. The paper does not establish a combined 512-pair median. Figure 2d 0.88 is an illustrated pair and cannot replace either full-panel result. Shared sessions create pair dependence.

comparison.primary_metric: Task-stratified median variance-weighted R² on the complete original isometric-force and reaching-cursor-velocity session-pair panels

published_baseline.description: Primary isometric force panel (Figure 3): median R²0.91 across 380 Jango pairs. Mandatory separate reaching panel (final Figure 4): median R²0.78 across 132 Chewie pairs. These are separate task-specific baselines;0.91 is not a combined score. The Figure 2d illustrated Day0→Day95 score0.88 after116 epochs cannot establish either complete panel.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No exact source-paper rerun score is established. Author demo provides a route but Ridge.score aggregation, regularization search and trial partition differ from paper Methods; recovered operators are inactive and do not supply authentic results.

minimum_effect.rationale: Justify meaningful task-specific gains only after resolving original scoring support and author replay variability, preserving reference/target label budgets and long-gap behavior. No arbitrary R² increment, pooled force/velocity average, or statistically significant but practically negligible win is admitted.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare paired candidate/author contrasts over the complete original panel with reference/test-session dependence and temporal structure retained. Candidate temporal/trial blocks require independent validation; no confidence level or resampling scheme is yet admitted.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Original biological animals and dependent reference/target session clusters; temporal/trial blocks are proposed within-session resampling units whose independence is not established. Neither 512 pairs nor optimization seeds are independent animals.
uncertainty.rationale: 380 directed pairs reuse 20 sessions and are not 380 independent animals; repeated optimization seeds do not create biological replication.

paper_win_requires: Recover complete original data, trial support, preprocessing and variance-weighted scoring for all 380 isometric and 132 reaching pairs, and reproduce both author panel baselines.

Surpass the source author method under a predeclared task-specific meaningful-gain and uncertainty rule while preserving original fixed-reference decoders, allowed neural/behavior access and resources; no invented pooled score.
Keep target-day behavior hidden from adaptation and candidate selection.
Do not substitute demo uniform-average scores, supervised target-day decoders, local authored baselines, new trial splits or selected favorable pairs for the original source comparison.

A Figure 2d pair improvement is calibration/subpanel evidence only and cannot satisfy this full original task. Preserve all original pairs, failures and task-specific controls; human online results require their own original evaluation.
Resolve source-code rights before prohibited modifications, redistribution or competitive use; independent implementation does not itself qualify source/data rights or comparison validity.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA claim; surpassing this source paper and surpassing later methods are separate source-verified comparisons.

episode.improvement_loop: Design only. After source-route and rights resolution, iterate alignment methods using original permitted reference-day labeled training and target-day neural-only adaptation plus predeclared development feedback. Preserve the complete original force and reaching task panels and label budgets.
episode.candidate_freeze: Seal method code/configuration, every reference state, adaptation/checkpoint rule, preprocessing, complete pair roster and evaluation support before final target behavior or comparisons are opened.
episode.final_evaluation: Run frozen candidate and source-author methods on all original 380 isometric and 132 reaching pairs, using Eq.4 R² and separate original median reductions. Report published 0.91/0.78, reproduced author values and candidate values separately, retaining failed pairs. No illustrated-pair result or combined 512-pair score can award task success.
episode.baseline_policy: Author baseline must match the paper metric, CV and support. Demo output and independent recovered operators are not automatically historical results; preserve their discrepancies and all broader original obligations.

blocking_issues: Complete original isometric/reaching data and train-validation-scoring trial identities, event support and preprocessing lineage unresolved.
Pinned demo Ridge.score and alpha/CV recipe differ from paper Methods.
Author rerun/reference result and working source-matched evaluator not qualified.
Pinned NoMAD license restrictions unresolved for a modifiable or competitive improvement task.
Task-specific meaningful effect, dependence-aware uncertainty and fixed concrete access/resource budgets not yet admitted.
All512 directed pairs and task-specific controls remain required; a Day0/Day95 demonstration cannot satisfy original complete-panel scope.

legacy.notes: Preserve Day0/Day95 demonstration and complete recovered-operator source obligations without alteration. Source inspection, operator correctness and reconstruction are calibration/design evidence, not achieved paper improvement.
